newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Sunwear to open 50 new stores.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Sunwear to open 50 new stores.

text.p: Pacific Sunwear of California Inc Friday said it plans to open 50 new stores in 1997 and 60 new stores in 1998.
In a statement the company said it had previously announced plans to open 40 new stores in 1997.
Based on these plans, the company said it expects to operate about 260 stores at the end of 1997 and 320 stores at the end of 1998.

The company also said in 1998 it will expand or relocate between 10 to 15 stores in existing malls (about 2,000 square feet) to the larger 3,000- square-foot format from to accommodate the addition of junior merchandise and footwear. The company had previously set expansions/relocation plans for compeltion in 1997.

The Company has targeted its most productive stores for expansion/relocation, most of which do not currently offer juniors and/or footwear. The new stores and expansions/relocations will increase total store square footage by about 33 percent for 1997 and 31 percent for 1998.
